decisions.reason: The policy also applies to the main board through the immediately preceding discussion, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing it.
The preceding context limits the bottom-side accessibility instruction to the vertically mounted main and sensor boards, not the power board.
This Requirement concerns battery-connector placement on the power board, while the source instruction concerns bottom-side accessibility on the main and sensor boards.
The source changes physical connector placement, not the interboard connector types, pinouts, matching order, or power topology owned by this Requirement.
Minimizing bottom-side connector placement does not change the required sensor connector inventory, connector count, types, or pin assignments.
The mechanical placement policy does not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.
The bottom-side placement instruction does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND connection or its I2C mode.
The source does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal-conditioning placement.
The connector accessibility instruction does not affect standalone regulator capacity, source selection, activation conditions, or powered loads.
The source does not identify the panel power-button connector or necessarily prescribe a new location for that independently specified control.
The source concerns general connector accessibility and does not change the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitances.
The mechanical connector-placement instruction does not alter the selected ESP32 module or its breakout requirement.
